summary: Frontend-only testing of RLW (Expo React Native Web). The reported BLOCKER (post-login hang on green spinner) could NOT be reproduced. Login with owner@rollow.id → dashboard (Beranda) renders in ~5s showing 'Halo, Owner', stat cards, Absensi Realtime, Menu Cepat tiles and bottom tabs. All feature flows verified end-to-end successfully. No console errors, no failed API calls (only CF /cdn-cgi/rum beacon aborts which are irrelevant).

blocker_diagnosis.note_on_gate_stack: data-testid='gate-stack' is set on <Stack> (expo-router) which is a NAVIGATOR component and does NOT render a DOM node with that attribute on web — this is a false-negative selector, NOT a bug. The dashboard content renders correctly inside the stack.
blocker_diagnosis.console_errors: none (only a benign Metro HMR 'Disconnected from Metro (1006)' warning after first paint)
blocker_diagnosis.failed_requests: only Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/rum beacons (ERR_ABORTED) — unrelated to app
blocker_diagnosis.conclusion: The app loads and renders the dashboard correctly after login. The main agent's blocker report may have been from an earlier revision or an environment-specific issue (browser w/o IndexedDB, stale cached bundle). If the user still sees a hang, ask them to hard-refresh (the Metro bundle may have been stale).

verified_flows: Login (owner@rollow.id / Rollow@2026) → lands on Dashboard '/' with greeting 'Halo, Owner' and stat cards (Penjualan, Transaksi, Laba Kotor, Pemasukan, Pengeluaran, Cash Flow)

Clock-in flow (crew@rollow.id, not yet clocked in): dashboard-clock-in-button present → clicked → camera-overlay opens with live getUserMedia video stream. Headless browser DID grant camera (fake stream), so camera-error path not exercised but the camera-error branch exists in code.
Kas Outlet /m/cash: cash-balance-value='Rp 40.000', Kas Awal Rp 50.000, Uang Masuk Rp 0, Pengeluaran Kas Rp 10.000, formula shown correctly, history list renders 'Bahan Baku KELUAR -Rp 10.000'

Finance /m/finance: finance-outlet-expense=Rp 10.000, finance-finance-expense=Rp 25.000, finance-total-expense=Rp 35.000; tabs finance-tab-all / finance-tab-kasir / finance-tab-finance present; records tagged with KAS OUTLET vs FINANCE badges
POS /pos manual item sheet: pos-manual-button → manual-item-sheet opens with 'Hubungkan ke menu' row containing 7 manual-link-* chips (menu linking works, stock will auto-decrement)

POS /pos external order sheet: pos-external-button → external-sheet opens with ext-platform chips (ShopeeFood/GoFood/GrabFood), ext-orderno-input, menu chips & ext-link chips. CONFIRMED: ZERO price inputs in the external sheet (0 matches for harga/price inputs) — matches requirement.
action_items: If any user still reports post-login spinner hang, instruct them to hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) to flush the Metro dev bundle; data in IndexedDB (@react-native-async-storage) can get wedged across Metro restarts.

Consider replacing testID='gate-stack' on <Stack> with a wrapping <View testID='gate-stack'><Stack/></View> so that automated tests can actually detect the mounted stack via DOM. Currently the testID silently gets dropped because <Stack> is a navigator, not a DOM node — this contributed to the false blocker signal from the main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: src/auth.tsx: useEffect loads /auth/me only if token exists then setLoading(false) in finally — safe pattern, no infinite loading risk observed.
app/_layout.tsx Gate: testID='gate-stack' on <Stack> is NOT a real DOM attribute on web — misleading for test tooling. Wrap in a View or use document.querySelector on the stack's rendered children.
src/api.ts: good — uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var, handles 401 via onUnauthorized callback. Error message 'Terjadi kesalahan, coba lagi' is user-friendly.
test_credentials: owner@rollow.id / Rollow@2026 (and crew@rollow.id for clock-in test) — all working
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 features from the review request verified passing on https://rlw3-main.preview.emergentagent.com. Login, dashboard, Kas Outlet (/m/cash), Finance (/m/finance with source separation tabs), POS manual-item with menu-link chips, POS external-sheet with NO price inputs, clock-in camera overlay — all working. The data-testid='gate-stack' selector returns false even on a working dashboard because <Stack> is a navigator component and the testID doesn't propagate to DOM on web — do not use that selector as a readiness signal; instead check for 'Halo,' greeting text or data-testid='tab-home'.
